subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord retain a channel-local session-conflict retry after the shared self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, or should recovery be consolidated in shared session initialization?
rationale: Both layers address the same conflict class, but retaining both changes timing and state ownership; repository evidence cannot establish the intended permanent boundary.

options.title: Consolidate shared recovery
options.body: Use the proof-positive shared self-heal as the canonical recovery and avoid a second channel-specific retry policy.

options.title: Keep Discord fallback
options.body: Retain the local retry only after replay-release repair and proof of a residual Discord failure not covered by shared recovery.

recommendation.title: Consolidate shared recovery
recommendation.body: Use the proof-positive shared self-heal as the canonical recovery and avoid a second channel-specific retry policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the prepared Discord dispatch boundary affected by this decision.
